query:
UPDATE
            flow
        SET
            path = $1,
            summary = $2,
            description = $3,
            dependency_job = NULL,
            lock_error_logs = '',
            tag = $4,
            dedicated_worker = $5,
            visible_to_runner_only = $6,
            ws_error_handler_muted = $7,
            value = $8,
            schema = $9::text::json,
            edited_by = $10,
            edited_at = now(),
            labels = COALESCE($13, labels),
            on_behalf_of_permissioned_as = $14
        WHERE
            path = $11 AND workspace_id = $12
